# 1.2.103 - The GM's large windows on one layout kit: Room setup, the item windows, Sound, Despair Flow, Season setup, the Class Trial console and the vote, the incident tracker, Murder, Edit campaign, the GM panel and one case window, Investigation, Students with a Role, Level Up and Items on every row, the project windows and the new surfaces, and the fix round of comparisons 2 and 3

Stages E46 and E47 (E47 `with` E46), one train, built on one line from 4de21046 (the slices were cut on 3c952c67) and merged with the hotfix 1.2.102
(E96) at 65024c09. The range is `v1.2.102..bc8ee2d8`: 34 commits: one merge (the hotfix, 65024c09) and four commits
that only regenerate the registry, the CSS budget and the style baseline after a wave, with one (552d6d69) that only updates
two tests' counts. Every window keeps its content and its order
(the owner's D31, option 1); what changes is how it is drawn: one kit of tables, forms, checklists, footers and boxes
for every large GM window, in both themes. The owner saw three before/after comparisons (09.11.2026 and 10.11.2026);
his asks from them are built here (The owner's answers). Nothing in this version ran at a real table or in Foundry;
what was measured was measured headless and in Chromium on the module's own harness pages. The gaps are in Known gaps
and Checked.

## Before installing

One new setting, nothing else to do. **Wide project windows** (Configure Settings, per browser, off by default): on,
Create a project, Edit project and Propose a project open at the kit's wide width on that screen; off, they open at
the width they always had. It is read when a window opens, so an open window keeps its width until it is opened again.
There is no world migration: `scripts/migrate.mjs` is unchanged, no flag is renamed (Room setup's `drpgRoomImage`
among them), and no socket listener, bridge row, guard, roll or GM store row is added or changed (the two commits held to the module's closer trust review, the GM panel's case window and the new surfaces,
say so in their messages). Both stages declare `touches`
`[]` in `tools/stages.json`. Back up the world as before any update.

## The kit (E46-C1, E46-C1f, E47-KFa, E47-KFb)

- Tables: group rows across every column with a count, a head cut after two lines with the whole name in its tooltip
  (the owner's rule for every long head, "consistent with the other tables"), a body cell cut after two lines the same
  way, column width kinds, a compact number stepper for a table cell, an icon button. A checklist that is red only for
  a row that blocks. A footer whose buttons keep fixed places through a window's states, the next step on the right
  and first for Enter, a destructive button never the default. Two stated widths. R2002-R2009.
- The kit's own fixes after the windows were built: switches, chips, steppers, form rows and table heads take their
  attributes and words through the kit, a disabled button is drawn as disabled, a role button, the checklist's marks,
  the form grid's select. R2086-R2089.
- Tab bars (comparison 1): a bar that cannot hold its tabs on one line now wraps them left to right, each at its own
  width, one row filled before the next, never stacked in a column grid (under Polish Legacy the last row's tabs
  stretch to share the bar, which the owner kept). R2090, R1325.

## Room setup (E46-C2a, E46-C2b, E47-FD)

- Every room tab is a kit table with the room first. Searching's token count is a stepper in its own cell (one write
  a click) instead of a 128 px tall stepper a row; Stashes' student heads stand on two lines, cut with the whole name
  in the tooltip, under a legend of the icons; "This is a room" is a switch. Applying with nothing changed writes
  nothing, and every field of the old form is still there. R2010-R2016, R119, E46-T1.
- The room's picture keeps its column, with a warning of a large file (pixels and bytes) in its cell that never blocks
  Apply. R2015.
- Passages is a kit table in the owner's column order (Rooms, Kind, Shape, Origin, Who knows, At season start, the
  state, the actions) with the access chips; the wall and tunnel pick works as before. The Scenes tab is a form with
  the hall's cast pick in a table and a reserved row for E73's Zone A and Zone B. R2017, R2018.
- At 1024x768 the Search tab's table now fits the window (it stood 1088 px in a 929 px body); its place column gives
  way and its switches wrap. R3138.

## The item windows (E46-C3a, E46-C3b, E47-KFb, E47-FC)

- Item tables: the pick list and a pool's entries are kit tables. The editor's four states tell the truth: the picked
  entry's own category, tier and roles. R2020, R2021, R2024, R2025.
- Give an existing item takes its category and tier from the table's entry (when the table does not say, both selects start at "- choose -" with the line "The tables do not say what this item
  is: choose its category and tier to give it." under them, and Give waits until both are chosen) and its
  roles from the tier where several apply. R2022, E46-T2.
- A Truth Bullet from a trace with no name is called "Remnant" (EN and PL) and nothing is written unless the GM renames
  it. R2023.
- Give / take items (comparison 1): the empty band on the right is gone under the glass (the body fills the window:
  722 / 873 px where it stood 544, the window's width unchanged). The recipient select starts on the character the
  window was opened for (R2091). Give > Create new gives the new item its category's icon at once (E47-T7 holds it), and since
  comparison 2 the window shows that icon before the press. R3135.

## The Class Trial console, the vote and the GM panel's Next line (E47-C1, E47-FA, E47-FD)

- One table says the trial's next step, and the console, the vote window and the GM panel's Next line all read it,
  so the three say the same thing in the same words. No step closes the trial; the verdict does not either.
  R2050, R2051, E47-T1.
- The console's footer keeps its buttons in fixed places in every state of a mode and is redrawn in place: the next
  step on the right and Enter's, End the trial, End the chapter and Start the Final Trial in a destructive group on
  the left, never pressed by Enter. Start the Final Trial with no Mastermind is greyed with its reason. The console's
  text runs the window's full width. R2052-R2055.
- Comparison 2's pictures showed the footer cut at both ends at 1366x768; that was the comparison's page builder, not
  the module (E47-FA, E47-FT), so the footer is unchanged, and the fit sweep now reads footers against the window (R2092). Comparison 3: under the glass a disabled button with a kit role (Close and count before the vote,
  Start the Final Trial with no Mastermind) is grey and dimmed, a destructive one too; Legacy as before. R3137.

## Students (E47-C8; the owner's ask of 09.11.2026)

## Known gaps

- **Observe still scrolls** at 1366x768 in both themes and at 1920x1080 under the glass, with the shorter captions
  too. One layout for every action that fits is E68's (1.2.105). The fit sweep's three red readings are these.
- **Legacy's one-word heads in the Remnants (Traces) table** break inside the word with the pixel face at 1366x768:
  "description", "Visibility", "Reinforced"; in Polish also "naprawdę", "Widoczność", "Powiązany", "Znalazł". The whole
  name is in the head's tooltip. Left to E98 (1.2.109), where the case map becomes the default view (AUDIT 449).
- **Who has what on its own tab, with each student's items by name**, is E98's, not this version's.
- **Students under Legacy** at 1366x768 with a Monocub and a Monokuma fit with about 2 px to spare: a longer name or a
  classic scrollbar would cut the last column. The Role select's "Monokuma" runs into its arrow under Legacy.
- **Room setup at 1024x768** is now 919 px wide with its nine tabs on two rows, and the Search tab's rows are taller
  (the switches wrap); its allowance for Foundry's window frame is not measured on v14 (LIVE-E47-11).
- **Polish under Legacy**, seen and not fixed: in the Key planner "Standardowy" runs into the Name field at 1366x768;
  in Give > Create new "Użytkowy - Leczący - 0/3" breaks over two lines in its select; the tracker's two footer
  buttons and the case window's footer can wrap to two lines.
- **Legacy's console and vote footers**, in English too: the left group (Close and the destructive buttons) wraps
  onto two lines in a 670 px footer.
- **A disabled destructive button under Legacy** keeps its red edge (only the ink and wash grey), as before.
- **Seven warnings still drawn the older way**, outside any window these stages rebuilt: Start a project's line on an
  indirect murder, a Call priced past what is held, the Mastermind window, a GM ruling made void, a Loaded Die's free
  critical, the Objection's evidence pick and Use an item's confirmation. No unshipped stage names them yet. The
  verdict's and the item tables' whispers to the GMs keep the chat card's warning.
- **Under the glass** the current GM panel tile's icon can read faint, and Delete's trash icon in the project manager
  is drawn in bone, not the destructive colour.
- **Searching and Passages rows are tall** under the glass (the chips wrap; a Passages row with a long access note
  about 232 px). A student's Passages chip is now the button that takes the passage back (pressed = has it).
- **The room picture warning** reads every stored picture once when Room setup opens (a request and a decode each).
- **Season setup under Legacy:** the intro and the campaign fieldset's note set their lines overlapping in the pixel
  face, as before this version (left to E48).
- **The card of rolls made with no GM:** under the glass its two buttons wrap to two lines in Polish at 340 px; under
  Legacy the GM's button reads black on dark red in the harness's stand-in (colour is E48's; a table will tell).
- **The suite's own message** (`game.drpg.runTests()` refusing tier 2 while an incident is open; tiers 0-1 still run) still says "Close the
  murder"; the tracker's button is End the murder. The module's windows are not affected.
- **The live checks** (AUDIT 9.2), not yet done at a real table: LIVE-E46-01 Room setup, 02 the room picture warning on
  a real server, 03 Sound's Effects, 04 Item tables with Foundry's sheet, 05 Season setup and Pre-season checks,
  06 Overflow with two GMs, 07 E46's Polish labels; LIVE-E47-01 the console's footer on v14's DialogV2, 02 the tracker
  at a table, 03 the panel's tiles in an Eclipse, 04 the case window's Back up and Restore on a real server with two
  GMs, 05 a roll's status card, 06 Foundry's settings window, 07 the Foundry tools and Map tools frames' theme,
  08 the Students window with a player connected, 09 the Investigation dashboard under Foundry's stylesheet in Legacy,
  10 the Polish labels in every E47 window, 11 E47-FD's fixes (the greyed buttons, Room setup at 1024x768, Analyze, the
  Look fieldset on a phone).
